n1c42518eb9.headline: Melisron: revenues rose by 6% - 223 million shekels
n1c42518eb9.summary: Melisron, an income-generating real estate company, reported a 6% revenue increase to 223 million shekels, with NOI up 22% and FFO up 42.5%.
n1c42518eb9.why: Strong operational recovery post-pandemic signals improving real estate market conditions and investor returns in Israel.

nb95e76f0ed.headline: CBN moves to recover unpaid Anchor Borrowers' Programme’s N463bn loan
nb95e76f0ed.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria has initiated efforts to recover N463 billion in unpaid loans from beneficiaries of its Anchor Borrowers' Programme.
nb95e76f0ed.why: The Anchor Borrowers' Programme is a key agricultural financing initiative in Nigeria, and loan recovery efforts affect banking sector asset quality and agricultural productivity.
